releases.title: Child assistant (Report Builder)
notes: Child assistant in the Report Builder (Administrators): draft MDT meeting packs, panel reports and DSD progress reports from the child's record, with the source of every fact shown. Team sections and recommendations are left for people to write.
Ask a question about a child in plain words, such as when a court order expires. Every answer shows where it came from.
Optional AI wording help, off by default and only for a model on your own network. Names and reference numbers are hidden from it.
Ask in your own words: Help understands plain questions (build 100.144).
